raw_market.question: Texas vs. Oklahoma: 3Q O/U 16.5
raw_market.description:
In the third quarter of the college football game between Texas and Oklahoma, scheduled for October 10 at 3:30 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Over" if Texas and Oklahoma combine to score 17 or more points in the third quarter.

If the combined third quarter total is less than 17, this market will resolve to "Under".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
